A student poured 10 cm of a solution containing 100 mg dm of protein into the syringe
containing beads. The beads contain protease.
At first the clip was fully open and it took 6 seconds to collect a 1.0 cm sample of the protein
solution.
The student poured away the remaining protein solution, washed the beads and put them
back into the syringe. The student repeated the procedure with fresh protein solution and
slightly closed the clip so that it took 15 seconds to collect a 1.0 cm sample of the protein
solution.
This procedure was carried out three more times closing the clip more each time. The student
measured the concentration of protein in each of the 1.0 cm samples.
